description: Build agent loops that go back when review fails, run them on real BB threads, and watch every step live. A node spawns a thread rather than calling a model, so workers appear in the sidebar and run on the providers you already have. Describe a flow in the chat and the agent builds and starts it, or open the studio from the command palette; the run shows up as a live card in the thread. 31 templates, human and dialogue nodes, per-attempt token counts, checkpointed runs. The work templates use Matt Pocock's skills, a separate install (npx skills add mattpocock/skills).
